title: Revise PTE
base_method: selected problem snapshot 931cc78db2e3c6ffe2654e9b44caf3dcdc344d23 is PR #69 actual merge-base and historical branch parent; export uses its immutable first parent 81bddf830c1e0bbc864babf971b1989fe9decc13 as truthful historical comparison and does not represent this as PR #69 repair diff

verification.snapshot_selection: The selected problem snapshot is PR #69's actual merge base and historical branch parent. Because it is also the problem state before the first repair commit, use its immutable first parent for the exported comparison: 81bddf830c1e0bbc864babf971b1989fe9decc13 -> 931cc78db2e3c6ffe2654e9b44caf3dcdc344d23. This is the historical merge of PR #67 and must not be represented as PR #69's repair diff. The archived live base 44aefda21983fd0b955c565b8e22d29800bc48cc is not an ancestor of the PR head; its merge-base with the head is 931cc78db2e3c6ffe2654e9b44caf3dcdc344d23.
verification.zero_issues_meaning: Not applicable; this snapshot contains one adjudicated semantic issue.
verification.source_export: Fixed Git objects, blob hashes and written bytes checked; full-index binary diff regenerated.
verification.toolchain: Direct bit-52 witness distinguishes the masks. Compatible Verus problem/final targets report 501/0 and 497/0; both passes are expected because x86 field width is not a built-in verifier rule.

verification_summary: Two independent reviewers confirmed that the problem mask retains bit 52 and other bits above the maximum x86-64 PTE physical-address field. The direct witness PageTableEntry(1 << 52).paddr() returns 1 << 52 at the selected problem snapshot and zero with repair 20ba976d. Compatible historical Verus runs pass both snapshots because the verifier checks the declared mask and has no built-in x86 PTE-width rule.
